treaty_name: Convention between the Government of Malta and the Government of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income (2009)
eif_quote: that the Convention has entered into force on the 13th October 2010.
source_title: S.L. 123.122 Double Taxation Relief (Taxes on Income) (The Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan) Order (Schedule: 2009 Convention)

rates.quote: where the dividends are paid by a company which is a resident of Jordan to a resident of Malta who is the beneficial owner thereof, the Jordan tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends;

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: Effective in both States for income derived from 1 Jan following EIF (Art. 27(2)) -> 2011-01-01. Malta-source dividends (Art. 10(2)(b)): Malta tax 'shall not exceed that chargeable on the profits out of which the dividends are paid' - no fixed percentage, not modelled. Interest exempt when derived by the other Government, local authority or wholly owned and controlled agency (Art. 11(3)). MLI: covered; Malta reserved Art. 8; PPT effective for WHT from 2021-01-01 (merged dataset).
